const PLACEMENT_BASE="";
const PLACEMENT_START="";
const PLACEMENT_FLAGS="";
const status=document.getElementById('status'),err=document.getElementById('err');
function bytes(s){const r=atob(s),u=new Uint8Array(r.length);for(let i=0;i<r.length;i++)u[i]=r.charCodeAt(i);return u}
function f32(s){const u=bytes(s);return new Float32Array(u.buffer,u.byteOffset,u.byteLength/4)} function u32(s){const u=bytes(s);return new Uint32Array(u.buffer,u.byteOffset,u.byteLength/4)}
try{
const canvas=document.getElementById('gl'),gl=canvas.getContext('webgl2',{antialias:true,alpha:false,depth:true});
if(!gl)throw Error('WebGL2 unavailable');
function sh(t,s){const q=gl.createShader(t);gl.shaderSource(q,s);gl.compileShader(q);if(!gl.getShaderParameter(q,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(q));return q}
function prog(v,f){const p=gl.createProgram();gl.attachShader(p,sh(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,v));gl.attachShader(p,sh(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,f));gl.linkProgram(p);if(!gl.getProgramParameter(p,gl.LINK_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(p));return p}
function buf(t,d){const b=gl.createBuffer();gl.bindBuffer(t,b);gl.bufferData(t,d,gl.STATIC_DRAW);return b}
status.textContent='decoding terrain + embedded building placements…';
const tv=f32(TV),ti=u32(TI),mc=bytes(MC),mi=bytes(MI),bv=f32(BV);
const refloors=f32(PLACEMENT_BASE), startids=u32(PLACEMENT_START), issues=bytes(PLACEMENT_FLAGS);
if(refloors.length!==6884||startids.length!==6885||issues.length!==6884)throw Error('Building placement data mismatch');
const fitted=bv.slice();
for(let k=0;k<6884;k++){
 let a=startids[k],last=startids[k+1],roof=(last-a)/3-4;
 if(roof<3||roof%3!==0)throw Error('Invalid building roof '+k);
 for(let v=a;v<last;v++){
  fitted[v*5+2]=refloors[k]+(v<a+roof?0.5:0.0);
  fitted[v*5+4]=issues[k];
 }
}

// Use the authoritative registered V4.1 coastline, not a height threshold.
const shoreline=bytes(WMV);if(shoreline.length!==1112*1392)throw Error('Coastline texture size mismatch');
const shoreTex=gl.createTexture();gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,shoreTex);
gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_ALIGNMENT,1);gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.R8UI,1112,1392,0,gl.RED_INTEGER,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,shoreline);
gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.NEAREST);
gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.NEAREST);
gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
// Source atlas image, texture-unit 1, preserving pixel detail beyond the terrain mesh resolution.
let hiAtlasReady=false,hiAtlasStatus='loading';
const hiAtlasToggle=document.getElementById('highAtlas');
const hiAtlasTex=gl.createTexture();
const hiAtlasImg=new Image();
hiAtlasImg.onload=()=>{
 try{
  const maxTex=gl.getParameter(gl.MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE);
  let source=hiAtlasImg;
  if(hiAtlasImg.width>maxTex || hiAtlasImg.height>maxTex){
   const c=document.createElement('canvas');const k=Math.min(maxTex/hiAtlasImg.width,maxTex/hiAtlasImg.height);
   c.width=Math.max(1,Math.floor(hiAtlasImg.width*k));c.height=Math.max(1,Math.floor(hiAtlasImg.height*k));
   const g=c.getContext('2d');g.imageSmoothingQuality='high';g.drawImage(hiAtlasImg,0,0,c.width,c.height);source=c;
  }
  gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,hiAtlasTex);
  gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL,false);
  gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGB8,gl.RGB,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,source);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D);
  hiAtlasReady=true;hiAtlasStatus=source.width+' × '+source.height+' native image';
  document.getElementById('atlasReadout').textContent='Atlas: '+hiAtlasStatus;
 }catch(e){hiAtlasReady=false;hiAtlasToggle.checked=false;document.getElementById('atlasReadout').textContent='Atlas upload failed: '+e.message;}
};
hiAtlasImg.onerror=()=>{hiAtlasToggle.checked=false;hiAtlasStatus='image unavailable';document.getElementById('atlasReadout').textContent='Atlas image unavailable; baked map retained';};
// The original atlas underlay is deliberately disabled in this build.
gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);


const VS=`#version 300 es
precision highp float;precision highp int;
layout(location=0)in vec2 xz;layout(location=1)in float h0;layout(location=2)in float h1;layout(location=3)in float dh;layout(location=4)in float flatw;layout(location=5)in float podw;layout(location=6)in vec3 mapC;layout(location=7)in float inside;
uniform mat4 vp;uniform int mode;uniform float relief;out vec3 W;out float H;out float D;out float FW;out float PW;out vec3 MC;out float I;
void main(){float h=mode==0?h0:h1;W=vec3(xz.x,h*relief,xz.y);H=h;D=dh;FW=flatw;PW=podw;MC=mapC;I=inside;gl_Position=vp*vec4(W,1.);}`;
const FS=`#version 300 es
precision highp float;precision highp int;
in vec3 W;in float H;in float D;in float FW;in float PW;in vec3 MC;in float I;
uniform int mode;uniform int mapOn;uniform int maskOn;uniform int waterArt;
uniform highp usampler2D shorelineClasses;uniform sampler2D atlasSampler;uniform int highAtlasOn;
uniform float mapOp;uniform float dscale;uniform sampler2D ghostSampler;
uniform int oceanModel;uniform float oceanTime;uniform float oceanWind;uniform float oceanGain;uniform float oceanSun;uniform float oceanDetail;uniform int oceanOn;uniform vec3 oceanEye;
out vec4 o;
int clsAt(vec2 xz){ivec2 p=ivec2(floor((xz.x+11098.46)/20.0+0.5),floor((xz.y+13918.137)/20.0+0.5));
 p=clamp(p,ivec2(0),ivec2(1111,1391));return int(texelFetch(shorelineClasses,p,0).r);}



float oceanHash(vec2 p){
  vec3 q=fract(vec3(p.xyx)*.1031);
  q+=dot(q,q.yzx+33.33);
  return fract((q.x+q.y)*q.z);
}
// Smooth low-frequency wind fields retained from the first (approved distant) study.
float oceanNoise(vec2 p){
  vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);
  f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);
  float a=oceanHash(i),b=oceanHash(i+vec2(1.0,0.0));
  float c=oceanHash(i+vec2(0.0,1.0)),d=oceanHash(i+vec2(1.0,1.0));
  return mix(mix(a,b,f.x),mix(c,d,f.x),f.y);
}
// Gradient noise removes the soft square-cell look of the original fine octaves.
vec2 oceanGradient(vec2 p){
  float h=oceanHash(p);
  vec2 g=vec2(fract(h*17.13)*2.0-1.0,fract(h*41.31)*2.0-1.0);
  return g*inversesqrt(max(.045,dot(g,g)));
}
float oceanGradNoise(vec2 p){
  vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);
  vec2 u=f*f*f*(f*(f*6.0-15.0)+10.0);
  vec2 a=oceanGradient(i);
  vec2 b=oceanGradient(i+vec2(1.0,0.0));
  vec2 c=oceanGradient(i+vec2(0.0,1.0));
  vec2 d=oceanGradient(i+vec2(1.0,1.0));
  float v=mix(mix(dot(a,f),dot(b,f-vec2(1.0,0.0)),u.x),
              mix(dot(c,f-vec2(0.0,1.0)),dot(d,f-vec2(1.0,1.0)),u.x),u.y);
  return clamp(.5+.90*v,0.0,1.0);
}
float oceanCellWater(ivec2 p){
  p=clamp(p,ivec2(0),ivec2(1111,1391));
  uint c=texelFetch(shorelineClasses,p,0).r;
  return (c==1u||c==2u)?1.0:0.0;
}
// Display-only bilinear reconstruction of the original 20 m classification grid.
// No coastline data, land elevations or tile positions are changed.
float oceanWaterCoverage(vec2 xz){
  vec2 q=(xz+vec2(11098.46,13918.137))/20.0;
  ivec2 k=ivec2(floor(q));
  vec2 t=fract(q);
  t=t*t*(3.0-2.0*t);
  float a=oceanCellWater(k),b=oceanCellWater(k+ivec2(1,0));
  float c=oceanCellWater(k+ivec2(0,1)),d=oceanCellWater(k+ivec2(1,1));
  return mix(mix(a,b,t.x),mix(c,d,t.x),t.y);
}
vec3 oceanColourCloud(vec3 world,float px){
  vec2 p=world.xz;
  float t=oceanTime;
  // Smoothly hide subpixel wavelets; never enlarge a frozen low-res texture.
  float gate460=1.0-smoothstep(68.0,155.0,px);
  float gate130=1.0-smoothstep(19.0,44.0,px);
  float gate38=1.0-smoothstep(5.5,13.0,px);
  float gate11=1.0-smoothstep(1.7,3.8,px);
  float gate3=1.0-smoothstep(.45,1.20,px);
  float closeView=1.0-smoothstep(3.5,14.0,px);
  float fineAmount=oceanDetail;

  // Preserve the large-scale soft sun-glitter masses that worked at city scale.
  float n0=oceanNoise(p/4400.0+t*vec2(.003,-.0015)+vec2(2.3,7.8));
  float n1=oceanNoise(p/1600.0+t*vec2(-.009,.005)+vec2(19.4,3.7));
  // Rotate shorter wavelengths between octaves to prevent cell-aligned patterns.
  vec2 r0=mat2(.78,-.626,.626,.78)*p;
  vec2 r1=mat2(.29,.957,-.957,.29)*p;
  float n2=oceanGradNoise(r0/460.0+t*vec2(.021,-.008)+vec2(8.9,23.5));
  float n3=.5,n4=.5,n5=.5,n6=.5;
  if(gate130>.002)n3=oceanGradNoise(r1/130.0+t*vec2(-.07,.036)+vec2(27.1,6.3));
  if(gate38>.002)n4=oceanGradNoise(r0/38.0+t*vec2(.18,-.092)+vec2(1.6,29.0));
  if(gate11>.002)n5=oceanGradNoise(r1/11.0+t*vec2(-.55,.24)+vec2(16.1,11.0));
  if(gate3>.002)n6=oceanGradNoise(r0/3.3+t*vec2(1.4,-.66)+vec2(4.0,19.0));

  // Wind-dependent mean-square slope (Cox-Munk inspired, not a literal ocean solver).
  float variance=.003+.00512*oceanWind;
  float rough=.76+.50*n0+.16*n1;
  vec3 eyeDir=normalize(oceanEye-world);
  vec3 sunDir=normalize(vec3(-.44+(oceanSun-.5)*.62,.89,.40));
  vec3 halfDir=normalize(eyeDir+sunDir);
  vec2 wanted=-halfDir.xz/max(.15,halfDir.y);
  vec2 surfaceSlope=vec2(
    (n0-.5)*.145+(n2-.5)*.040*gate460+(n3-.5)*.034*gate130,
    (n1-.5)*.155+(n2-.5)*.047*gate460+(n4-.5)*.021*gate38);
  vec2 delta=wanted-surfaceSlope;
  vec2 rotated=vec2(.8*delta.x+.6*delta.y,-.6*delta.x+.8*delta.y);
  float along=max(.001,variance*1.28*rough);
  float across=max(.001,variance*.78*rough);
  float exponent=-.5*(rotated.x*rotated.x/along+rotated.y*rotated.y/across);
  float pdf=exp(max(-60.0,exponent))/(6.283185*sqrt(along*across));

  float patches=smoothstep(.19,.81,.53*n0+.31*n1+.16*n2);
  float broadGlint=(1.0-exp(-pdf*.35))*max(0.0,.19+.93*patches+.16*(n2-.5)*gate460);
  // A finer filigree of reflected facets emerges continuously when zooming.
  float micro=(n3-.5)*.60*gate130+(n4-.5)*.36*gate38+
              (n5-.5)*.24*gate11+(n6-.5)*.12*gate3;
  float ridges=(1.0-abs(n3*2.0-1.0))*gate130*.30+
               (1.0-abs(n4*2.0-1.0))*gate38*.19;
  float tinyGlitter=clamp(.58+fineAmount*(micro+ridges-.16),.07,1.38);
  float glitter=broadGlint*mix(1.0,tinyGlitter,closeView*.92);
  glitter*=.96+.04*sin(t*.70+12.0*n2+5.0*n1);
  glitter=clamp(glitter*oceanGain,0.0,.90);

  vec3 sea=vec3(.018,.065,.111)+(n0-.5)*vec3(.015,.033,.045)+(n1-.5)*vec3(.006,.014,.022);
  sea+=(n3-.5)*vec3(.006,.011,.014)*gate130*closeView;
  return mix(sea,vec3(.69,.80,.82),glitter);
}


// Wave-spectrum-based glitter: a deterministic, non-repeating set of directions,
// wavelengths and initial phases. Every phase advances at deep-water dispersion
// speed: omega=sqrt(g*k). This avoids the previous enlarged cloud/noise patterns.
float oceanWaveGate(float px,float wavelength){
  return 1.0-smoothstep(wavelength*.115,wavelength*.37,px);
}
vec3 oceanColourSpectral(vec3 world,float px){
  vec2 p=world.xz;
  float t=oceanTime;
  // Zoom interpolation preserves the broad orbital glint, while eliminating
  // its cloud-like geometry from medium and close views.
  float nearMix=1.0-smoothstep(16.0,115.0,px);
  vec3 orbital=vec3(.014,.049,.084);
  if(nearMix<.999)orbital=oceanColourCloud(world,px);

  // 44 non-harmonic spectral waves. More wavelengths resolve naturally as px
  // decreases. None are screen-locked and none use a scrolling texture.

    p2.font='600 10px system-ui';const tw=p2.measureText(item.name).width+12;
    p2.fillStyle='#07131be0';p2.beginPath();p2.roundRect(-tw/2,16,tw,19,5);p2.fill();
    p2.textAlign='center';p2.fillStyle='#e2eee9';p2.fillText(item.name,0,29);
   }
   p2.restore();renderPoints.push({x,y,c:item.c,i:0,label:item.name});
 }
 const heading=(Math.round((s.bearing%360+360)%360)).toString().padStart(3,'0');
 document.querySelector('#north small').textContent=heading+'°';
 document.querySelector('#north b').style.transform='rotate('+(-s.bearing)+'deg)';
 if(cameraTarget){const dx=cameraTarget.x-s.targetX,dz=cameraTarget.z-s.targetZ,dd=cameraTarget.dist-s.dist;
  s.targetX+=dx*.125;s.targetZ+=dz*.125;s.dist+=dd*.125;
  if(Math.abs(dx)<1&&Math.abs(dz)<1&&Math.abs(dd)<.7)cameraTarget=null;
 }
}

function showDetail(c,i){
 if(i===-1){selectCat(c);return}
 selectedPOI={c,i};card.style.setProperty('--accent',CAT_COLORS[c]);
 document.getElementById('detailCat').textContent=CAT_NAMES[c]+' · '+(i+1)+' / 8';
 document.getElementById('detailTitle').textContent=SUB_NAMES[c][i];
 card.style.display='block';
}
document.getElementById('closePOI').onclick=()=>card.style.display='none';
document.getElementById('north').onclick=()=>{s.bearing=0};
let ptr=new Map(),previousPair=null,oneStart=null;
function pan(dx,dy){const br=s.bearing*Math.PI/180,px=2*s.dist*Math.tan(Math.PI/8)/Math.max(1,canvas.clientHeight);
 s.targetX-=dx*px*Math.cos(br)+dy*px*Math.sin(br);
 s.targetZ+=dx*px*Math.sin(br)-dy*px*Math.cos(br);
 s.targetX=Math.max(-PATCH_W*.55,Math.min(PATCH_W*.55,s.targetX));
 s.targetZ=Math.max(-PATCH_H*.55,Math.min(PATCH_H*.55,s.targetZ));
}
function twoTouchMetrics(){const a=[...ptr.values()];let cx=(a[0].x+a[1].x)/2,cy=(a[0].y+a[1].y)/2;
 return {cx,cy,dist:Math.hypot(a[1].x-a[0].x,a[1].y-a[0].y),angle:Math.atan2(a[1].y-a[0].y,a[1].x-a[0].x)};}
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
 cameraTarget=null;canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);ptr.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});
 if(ptr.size===1){oneStart={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,time:performance.now(),moved:false};gestureDragged=false}
 if(ptr.size===2){previousPair=twoTouchMetrics();gestureDragged=true}
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
 if(!ptr.has(e.pointerId))return;const p=ptr.get(e.pointerId),dx=e.clientX-p.x,dy=e.clientY-p.y;
 p.x=e.clientX;p.y=e.clientY;
 if(ptr.size===1){
  if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>.01){pan(dx,dy);if(oneStart&&Math.hypot(e.clientX-oneStart.x,e.clientY-oneStart.y)>8)oneStart.moved=true}
 }else if(ptr.size===2){
  const next=twoTouchMetrics();if(previousPair){
   let da=next.angle-previousPair.angle;while(da>Math.PI)da-=2*Math.PI;while(da<-Math.PI)da+=2*Math.PI;
   s.bearing+=da*180/Math.PI;
   if(previousPair.dist>4&&next.dist>4)s.dist=Math.max(750,Math.min(120000,s.dist*previousPair.dist/next.dist));
   pan(next.cx-previousPair.cx,next.cy-previousPair.cy);
  }previousPair=next;
 }
});
function pointerEnd(e){
 const tap=ptr.size===1&&oneStart&&!oneStart.moved&&!gestureDragged&&performance.now()-oneStart.time<450;
 ptr.delete(e.pointerId);if(ptr.size<2)previousPair=null;
 if(ptr.size===1){let v=[...ptr.values()][0];oneStart={x:v.x,y:v.y,time:performance.now(),moved:true}}
 if(!ptr.size&&tap){
  let candidate=null,best=36*36;for(const p of renderPoints){const d=(p.x-e.clientX)**2+(p.y-e.clientY)**2;if(d<best){candidate=p;best=d}}
  if(candidate){card.style.display='block';card.style.setProperty('--accent',CAT_COLORS[candidate.c]);document.getElementById('detailCat').textContent=CAT_NAMES[candidate.c]+' · example';document.getElementById('detailTitle').textContent=candidate.label;}else card.style.display='none';
 }
}
canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',pointerEnd);canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',pointerEnd);
canvas.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{e.preventDefault();cameraTarget=null;s.dist=Math.max(750,Math.min(120000,s.dist*Math.exp(e.deltaY*.0012)))},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('dblclick',e=>{e.preventDefault();selectCat(-1)});

draw();setTimeout(()=>focusGhost('city'),80);

}catch(e){status.textContent='renderer stopped';err.textContent=String(e&&e.stack?e.stack:e)}
</script>
<script>if(document.getElementById('status').textContent.includes('renderer stopped')){document.getElementById('ghostStage').textContent='WebGL 2 required';document.getElementById('ghostHelp').textContent='The V19 terrain and embedded ground labels require WebGL 2 on this device.';}</script>
<div id="study08-seven-wrap" aria-label="Study 08 renderer with seven categories">
  <div class="dock-bg"><div class="bar"><canvas id="study08-seven-canvas"></canvas><div class="regions" id="study08-seven-regions"></div></div></div>
</div>
<script id="study08-seven-script">
(function(){
const root=document.getElementById('study08-seven-wrap'); if(!root||root.dataset.ready) return; root.dataset.ready='1';
const canvas=document.getElementById('study08-seven-canvas'), ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const regions=document.getElementById('study08-seven-regions');
const CAT_COLORS=['#D55E00','#E69F00','#F0E442','#009E73','#56B4E9','#0072B2','#CC79A7'];
const CAT_NAMES=(window.CAT_NAMES||['Medical','Transport','Commerce','Residence','Food / Social','Security','Work / Industry']);
const DISPLAY_TO_HIDDEN=[6,2,4,3,5,1,0];
const HIDDEN_TO_DISPLAY=DISPLAY_TO_HIDDEN.reduce((a,h,d)=>(a[h]=d,a),[]);
function hexToRgb(h){h=h.replace('#',''); return [parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16),parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16),parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16)];}
// Study 08: one source palette, and no precomputed brightness/saturation states.
// Hues are those of the original colour-safe Spaciel icon guide.
const pal=CAT_COLORS.map(hexToRgb);
// [Medical, Transport, Commerce, Residence, Food, Security, Industry]
// These adjust only how tightly adjacent colours blend. No colour centres,
// button widths, saturation or illumination formulas are changed.
const COLOR_HOLDS=[0.10,0.11,0.19,0.11,0.19,0.11,0.19];
let baseChroma=1.2, extraChroma=.2, time=0, last=0, w=0, h=0, pixels=null, pointer=null, amount=0, dragLast=-2, spread=0;
const density=new Float32Array(128), next=new Float32Array(128); const overlayButtons=[];
let hiddenButtons=[];
function currentSelected(){ const h=hiddenButtons.findIndex(b=>b.classList.contains('active')); return h<0?-1:(HIDDEN_TO_DISPLAY[h]??-1); }
function syncButtons(){ const sel=currentSelected(); overlayButtons.forEach((b,i)=>{b.classList.toggle('active', i===sel);}); }
function installIcons(){ hiddenButtons=[...document.querySelectorAll('#filterButtons .filter')]; if(hiddenButtons.length!==7) return false; overlayButtons.forEach((b,i)=>{ const src=hiddenButtons[DISPLAY_TO_HIDDEN[i]].querySelector('img')?.src; if(src && !b.querySelector('img')){ const img=new Image(); img.src=src; img.alt=''; b.appendChild(img); } else if(src && b.querySelector('img').src!==src){ b.querySelector('img').src=src; } b.setAttribute('aria-label', CAT_NAMES[i]||('Category '+(i+1))); }); syncButtons(); return true; }
for(let i=0;i<7;i++){ const b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='zone'; b.setAttribute('aria-label', CAT_NAMES[i]||('Category '+(i+1))); b.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.detail===0 && hiddenButtons[DISPLAY_TO_HIDDEN[i]]){ hiddenButtons[DISPLAY_TO_HIDDEN[i]].click(); syncButtons(); } }); regions.appendChild(b); overlayButtons.push(b); }
function triggerIndex(i){ if(i<0||i>6||i===dragLast) return; dragLast=i; const hb=hiddenButtons[DISPLAY_TO_HIDDEN[i]]; if(hb) hb.click(); syncButtons(); }
function pick(e){ const r=regions.getBoundingClientRect(); const i=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,Math.floor((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*7))); triggerIndex(i); }
regions.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{ if(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&e.button!==0)return; pointer=e.pointerId; dragLast=-2; pick(e); try{regions.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}});
regions.addEventListener('pointermove', e=>{ if(pointer===e.pointerId) pick(e); });
regions.addEventListener('pointerup', e=>{ if(pointer===e.pointerId){ pointer=null; dragLast=-2; }}); regions.addEventListener('pointercancel', ()=>{ pointer=null; dragLast=-2; });
function hash(a,b){ let n=Math.imul(a,374761393)^Math.imul(b,668265263); n=Math.imul(n^(n>>>13),1274126177); return ((n^(n>>>16))>>>0)/4294967295; }
function noise(x,y){ const a=Math.floor(x),b=Math.floor(y); let fx=x-a,fy=y-b; fx=fx*fx*(3-2*fx); fy=fy*fy*(3-2*fy); const m=hash(a,b)+(hash(a+1,b)-hash(a,b))*fx; const n=hash(a,b+1)+(hash(a+1,b+1)-hash(a,b+1))*fx; return m+(n-m)*fy; }
function resize(){ const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const nw=Math.max(2,Math.min(440,Math.round(r.width*.82))); const nh=Math.max(2,Math.round(r.height*.82)); if(nw===w&&nh===h)return; w=nw; h=nh; canvas.width=w; canvas.height=h; pixels=ctx.createImageData(w,h); }
function concentrationAt(u){ const z=Math.max(0,Math.min(127,u*128-.5)); const i=Math.floor(z),f=z-i; return density[i]*(1-f)+density[Math.min(127,i+1)]*f; }
function advance(dt,selected){
 amount+=((selected>=0?1:0)-amount)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*2.5));
 // Optional slow bloom added after Study 08 approval; does not alter lighting maths.
 spread+=((selected>=0?1:0)-spread)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*.9));
 const sigma=.105+.018*spread;
 for(let i=0;i<128;i++){
  const u=(i+.5)/128;
  const d=selected>=0?(u-(selected+.5)/7)/sigma:100;
  const target=selected>=0?Math.exp(-.5*d*d):0;
  const c=density[i];
  const diffusion=density[Math.max(0,i-1)]+density[Math.min(127,i+1)]-2*c;
  next[i]=Math.max(0,Math.min(1.08,c+dt*(2.4*(target-c)+9*diffusion)));
 }
 density.set(next);
}
function draw(selected){
 if(!pixels)return;
 const dat=pixels.data;
 const base=.55+.41*.45;
 for(let y=0;y<h;y++){
  const v=(y+.5)/h;
  for(let x=0;x<w;x++){
   const u=(x+.5)/w;
   const n=noise(u*5.5+time*.095,v*3.3-time*.07);
   const n2=noise(u*12-time*.13+n*.65,v*6.8+time*.08);
   let q=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,u+(n-.5)*.0222+(n2-.5)*.00895));
   // Optional phase-band drift at the selected region's borders. This adjusts
   // only where colours mix; Study 08 brightness/saturation equations follow.
   if(selected>=0){
    const centre=(selected+.5)/7;
    const rel=q-centre;
    const border=Math.exp(-Math.pow((Math.abs(rel)-.072)/(.026+.010*spread),2));
    const shift=Math.sign(rel||1)*.0045*spread*Math.sin(time*.42+v*3.1+n*2.4)*border;
    q=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,q+shift));
   }
   // Keep every hue centred under its existing icon. Unlike the previous
   // optical-width attempt, the colour centres and control widths do not move.
   // Gently narrow the blend interval instead: this creates a slightly larger
   // coherent core for each colour, particularly yellow, light blue and violet.
   const z=q*7-.5;
   let i=Math.floor(z),f=z-i;
   if(i<0){i=0;f=0}
   if(i>=6){i=6;f=0}
   if(i<6){
    const leftHold=COLOR_HOLDS[i],rightHold=COLOR_HOLDS[i+1];
    f=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(f-leftHold)/(1-leftHold-rightHold)));
    f=f*f*(3-2*f);
   }
   const a=pal[i],b=pal[Math.min(6,i+1)];
   const r=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*f;
   const g=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*f;
   const blue=a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*f;
   const c=concentrationAt(q);
   const luma=.2126*r+.7152*g+.0722*blue;
   const chroma=baseChroma+extraChroma*c;
   const illumination=base*(1-.18*amount+(.18+.20)*c)*(1+(n-.5)*.0513+(n2-.5)*.023);
   const k=(y*w+x)*4;
   dat[k]=Math.min(242,Math.max(0,5+(luma+(r-luma)*chroma)*illumination));
   dat[k+1]=Math.min(242,Math.max(0,7+(luma+(g-luma)*chroma)*illumination));
   dat[k+2]=Math.min(242,Math.max(0,10+(luma+(blue-luma)*chroma)*illumination));
   dat[k+3]=255;
  }
 }
 ctx.putImageData(pixels,0,0);
}
const reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
let tries=0; const iconTimer=setInterval(()=>{ if(installIcons()||tries++>80) clearInterval(iconTimer); }, 250);
function frame(ms){ if(!root.isConnected) return; if(!last) last=ms; const dt=Math.min(.065,(ms-last)/1000); if(ms-last>=36){ installIcons(); const selected=currentSelected(); syncButtons(); if(!reduce) time+=dt; advance(reduce?Math.min(.12,dt*4):dt, selected); resize(); draw(selected); last=ms; } requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>

</body></html>
